expected_defects.defect: Markdown link to a package-relative file that does not exist

expected_non_defects.why: An absolute filesystem path is host coupling, reported by hardcoded_paths, not a package-relative reference. It must not also appear in broken_references.

Absolute-path classification must be OS-independent: a Windows drive-absolute path is recognised as absolute (and reported as hardcoded) even when the inspector runs on a non-Windows host, and vice versa.

notes: Regression fixture proving absolute-path classification (PurePosixPath/PureWindowsPath) is independent of the OS running the inspector. os.path.isabs() alone judges by the host OS's own path rules, which misclassifies a POSIX absolute path as package-relative when the inspector runs on Windows (observed cross-host on Antigravity/Windows, corpus revision 2331f2c). See RG-011.
